lines.text: In King Darius's fourth year, the word of the LORD came to Zechariah, and the people of Bethel sent men to plead.
The men from Bethel asked the priests and the prophets whether they should keep weeping and fasting in the fifth month.
The LORD asked whether their fasting in the fifth and seventh months for seventy years was really for Him, as the kings had proclaimed.
The LORD told them to administer true justice and not to oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner or the poor.
The LORD scattered them with a whirlwind into the wilderness of Sinai, and the land was left desolate behind them.
